children: The annual inflation rate in the US steadied at 3.4% in August 2026, the same as in July and in line with forecasts.
Gasoline prices rose 27.4% yoy, slightly more than 24.6% in July and fuel oil prices increased 52%, compared with 39.1% previously.
On the other hand, inflation eased for shelter, to 3% from 3.2%, and for food to 2.7% from 3%.
On a monthly basis, the CPI rose 0.4%, the most in three months, also matching forecasts.
Gasoline rose 3.9% in August, accounting for over one third of the monthly increase while natural gas (-1.1%) and electricity (-0.2%) fell.
Food edged up 0.1% while shelter rose 0.3%.
Other increases were also seen for communication (2.3%), airline fares (2.7%), education (0.8%) and used cars and trucks (0.4%).
Meanwhile, core CPI rose 0.3% on the month, above 0.2% in July and forecasts of 0.3%.
The annual rate however, slowed to 2.4%, the lowest reading since March 2021, from 2.5%, as expected.

title: US CPI Report Comes Broadly in Line with Forecasts
